run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T01:39:17Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend fired because frontend's outbound dependency calls were refused after two of its dependencies were restarted at 2026-11-17T01:37:43Z. For frontend, STATUS_CODE_ERROR span activity is zero before 01:39:17, peaks at 1193.3 spans per 5m at 01:43:17 and returns to zero from 01:50:17, while normal (UNSET) span volume stays flat, so this is a new error burst rather than a traffic change. Sampled traces show the errors are frontend HTTP 500s on GET /api/data whose grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client span failed with "14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080" (the ad Service ClusterIP), and HTTP 500s on POST /api/checkout whose path failed because checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge call got "connect: connection refused" to 100.70.188.60:8080 (the payment Service ClusterIP). Kubernetes events show Deployments ad and payment each scaled a new ReplicaSet up and the old one down at 01:37:43-01:37:47, and both new ReplicaSet pod templates carry kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T01:37:43Z with unchanged image and env, i.e. a rollout restart. The replacement pods started immediately but their applications were not listening: payment logged "payment gRPC server started on port 8080" at 01:38:56, ad logged "Ad service starting." at 01:42:10 and "Ad service started, listening on 8080" at 01:44:04. Neither Deployment defines a readiness or startup probe (ad CPU limit 50m, payment 20m), so the Services routed traffic to these pods while nothing was bound to port 8080, producing connection refusals in the callers. Affected entities with their own error evidence are frontend (the alerting service), checkout (own PlaceOrder/Charge errors), frontend-proxy and load-generator (their own 500 error spans). Checked and healthy/recovered: ad and payment now serve normally, all 21 otel-demo pods are Running/Ready with restart count 0, and all 5 nodes are Ready with no pressure conditions. The flagd fault-injection flags currently declared in ConfigMap flagd-config (adFailure=on, paymentFailure=100%) do not match the observed transport-level refusal path and are left as an unverified hypothesis; the actor that issued the rollout restarts cannot be determined because change_history is not integrated.

claims.text: For service_name=frontend the 5-minute increase of traces_span_metrics_calls_total with status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR is 0 at every point up to 01:39:17, first becomes non-zero at 01:39:17 (101.1 spans), peaks at 1193.3 spans at 01:43:17, decays and is 0 again from 01:50:17; STATUS_CODE_UNSET volume stays in the ~12,000-13,900 span range per 5m across the same period.

The cumulative frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR span counter is flat at 2126 until 01:39:00, rises to 3833 by 01:46:00 and stays at 3833 through 01:54:00, i.e. the error burst lasted about 7 minutes and then stopped.

The frontend error spans are concentrated on two dependency paths: span_name GET /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (peak 260 and 260 spans per 5m respectively) and span_name POST /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (peak 47.4 and 47.4 spans per 5m), plus tcp.connect (peak 14.7).

Sampled traces of frontend at 01:38:50 show GET /api/data and its server GET span returning http.status_code 500 with otel.status_code ERROR, and the child client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds failing with rpc.grpc.status_code 14 and grpc.error_message "14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080".

In namespace otel-demo the Service ad has ClusterIP 100.65.180.246 on port 8080 and the Service payment has ClusterIP 100.70.188.60 on port 8080, matching the two addresses that were refusing connections in the error spans.

Sampled trace at 01:38:51 shows checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client span failing with rpc.grpc.status_code 14 and otel.status_description "connection error: ... dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused", checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span failing with rpc.grpc.status_code 13 ("failed to charge card"), and frontend's POST /api/checkout returning http.status_code 500.

Namespace otel-demo events record at 01:37:43-01:37:47 a rollout of Deployments ad and payment: "Scaled up replica set ad-6cb57f76d from 0 to 1" and "Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0" with pod ad-554b849958-mbnxm "Stopping container ad", and the same pattern for payment-9c8ffb665 scaled up and payment-55766d76b9 scaled down with pod payment-55766d76b9-c4wgb stopped; the new pods ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 and payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 were Scheduled, Created and Started at 01:37:43-01:37:46.

The new ReplicaSets ad-6cb57f76d (ad Deployment revision 2) and payment-9c8ffb665 (payment Deployment revision 2) both carry the pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T01:37:43Z, while image (ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad / 2.1.3-payment) and container env (FLAGD_HOST, FLAGD_PORT, ports) are identical to the previous ReplicaSets ad-554b849958 / payment-55766d76b9, i.e. the pods were replaced by a restart of the same configuration, not by an image or config change.

Neither restarted workload defines a readiness or startup probe: the ad-6cb57f76d and payment-9c8ffb665 pod templates have readinessProbe and startupProbe empty, with container CPU limits of 50m (ad) and 20m (payment).

The replacement ad pod ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 logged "Ad service starting." at 01:42:10.827 and "Ad service started, listening on 8080" at 01:44:04.226, with no further log lines between 01:42:10 and 01:44:04 and request-handling lines ("Targeted ad request received...") only from 01:44:04 onward.

The replacement payment pod payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 logged "payment gRPC server started on port 8080" at 01:38:56.223 and then served charge requests ("Charge request received."/"Transaction complete.") from 01:39:26 onward, including at 01:40:58-01:40:59.

Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo was restarted at 2026-11-17T01:37:43Z; its previous sole pod (ReplicaSet ad-554b849958, replicas 0 after the change) was stopped at 01:37:46 while the replacement pod ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 only bound port 8080 at 01:44:04, and frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds calls to the ad ClusterIP 100.65.180.246:8080 were refused in that interval.

checkout is affected on its own evidence: its STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge rise from 9 at 01:39:00 to 42 by 01:41:00 and stay flat afterwards, matching the refusal of its charge call to the payment ClusterIP.

frontend-proxy and load-generator are affected only as callers of the failing requests: the sampled traces contain their own error spans with http.status_code 500 and otel.status_code ERROR on ingress / router frontend egress and on load-generator GET and POST for the same trace IDs whose frontend spans returned 500.

No crash, OOM or node-pressure signature was found: all 21 otel-demo pods are Running and Ready with restartCount 0 and no lastState termination reason, all 5 nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure=False, and Deployments ad and payment are at readyReplicas 1 / updatedReplicas 1 with generation 2 observed, so the rollout has completed.

The connection refusals are best explained by the restarted pods having no readiness/startup probe combined with very low CPU limits (ad 50m, payment 20m): the containers were reported Ready as soon as they started, so the ad and payment Services routed traffic to pods whose applications had not yet bound port 8080 (ad bound it at 01:44:04, payment at 01:38:56), and callers received ECONNREFUSED; the timing correlation supports this but direct proof of the CPU-limit contribution is not available.

ConfigMap flagd-config currently declares fault-injection flags adFailure with defaultVariant "on" and paymentFailure with defaultVariant "100%", but it is unknown whether those values were in effect during 01:37-01:46; the observed failures are transport-level connection refusals, and after the pods came up the ad service answered normal "Targeted ad request received" requests and payment completed charges, so these flags do not account for the observed failure path unless they were set at a different time.

Rejected: the paymentFailure flag (currently 100%) causing the checkout PlaceOrder failures. The failing oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge span failed at the transport layer with "dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused" (grpc status 14), not with an application-level charge error, and the payment pod logged "Transaction complete." for charges from 01:39:26 onward.

Rejected: a crash, OOMKill, eviction or node failure of the ad/payment pods as the cause. The replaced pods were removed by their own Deployment/ReplicaSet rollout (ScalingReplicaSet and SuccessfulDelete events for ad-554b849958 and payment-55766d76b9, SuccessfulCreate for the new ReplicaSets), the new pods show restartCount 0 with no lastState termination reason, no OOMKilled or Evicted pod event was returned, and all nodes are Ready without pressure.

Add readiness and startup probes on port 8080 to the ad and payment containers (and raise their CPU limits from 50m/20m) so a restarted pod is only added to Service endpoints after its gRPC server is listening, and use a surge-based rolling update (maxUnavailable 0) so the old pod keeps serving until the replacement is Ready; this would have prevented the refusals seen on the ad and payment ClusterIPs.

gaps: change_history is not integrated, so the identity of the actor or tool that issued the rollout restart (kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T01:37:43Z on Deployments ad and payment) and its intent cannot be determined.

The alerting rule for RequestErrorRate was not returned by list_prometheus_rules (no rule data), so the exact alert expression and the meaning of the reported value 2.5777777777777775 are unverified; only the underlying span-level error signals could be checked.
Frontend pod logs returned 0 bytes for frontend-675fd7b5c5-h8sk5 in the requested window, so frontend's own application error log lines could not be read.

Jaeger's newest trace in this target is at 2026-11-17T01:38:51 (data_as_of of trace queries), so there is no trace evidence for 01:38:51-01:46:00; the later part of the error window rests on Prometheus span metrics and pod logs.
ConfigMap flagd-config was read at query time (~01:56), not during the incident; its content and whether adFailure/paymentFailure were effective between 01:37 and 01:46 is unknown.
Logs of the previous ad and payment containers/pods are not available (the old pods were deleted and no previous container instance exists), so their final moments cannot be inspected.
The NetworkPolicy query for namespace otel-demo returned nothing (no_data), so the absence of NetworkPolicies cannot be asserted from that result.
next_steps: Review the change record / audit log outside this environment for the kubectl rollout restart of Deployments ad and payment at 2026-11-17T01:37:43Z to confirm the initiating actor and reason.
Confirm the intended flagd flag values for 01:37-01:46 from flagd's own change history or source of truth before deciding whether the adFailure/paymentFailure flags are relevant.
Consider adding readiness/startup probes and higher CPU limits to the ad and payment Deployments, and verify in a staging cluster how long a restarted ad pod takes to bind port 8080.
